GSTP.description: General Spring Type (GSTP). Defines a named general spring whose 6x6 symmetric stiffness (SPRING), mass (MASS) and damping (DAMPING) matrices are each supplied as 21 upper-triangular terms; the OPT_* flags toggle which of those matrices are active.

NAME.description: Name of the general spring type.

SPRING.description: Stiffness matrix (6x6 symmetric) given as 21 upper-triangular terms. Applied only when OPT_STIFFNESS is true. Values not supplied default to 0.

MASS.description: Mass matrix (6x6 symmetric) given as 21 upper-triangular terms. Applied only when OPT_MASS is true. Values not supplied default to 0.

DAMPING.description: Damping matrix (6x6 symmetric) given as 21 upper-triangular terms. Applied only when OPT_DAMPING is true. Values not supplied default to 0.

OPT_STIFFNESS.description: Use the stiffness matrix (SPRING). Defaults to false.

OPT_MASS.description: Use the mass matrix (MASS). Defaults to false.

OPT_DAMPING.description: Use the damping matrix (DAMPING). Defaults to false.
